note: iOS launch screens (apple-touch-startup-image): CSS width x height at the device pixel ratio, portrait. tools/app-icons.mjs renders a portrait and a landscape image for each; vite.config.js writes the <link> tags. iOS picks the one whose media query matches exactly, so a missing device simply shows the background colour.
devices: iPhone 14 Pro Max, 15 Plus/Pro Max, 16 Plus
